issues.jp_before: 母[はは]は子供[こども]に手[て]をよく洗[あら]う{ように言[い]いました|pt-quote}。
issues.problem: English 'The mother ... her child' mistranslates 母 (the speaker's own mother).
issues.action: English changed to 'My mother told the child to wash his hands well.'

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]はきっと来[こ]ない{と思[おも]います|pt-quote}。
issues.problem: English 'I think he surely will not come' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'I am sure he will not come.'

issues.jp_before: 京都[きょうと]{という|pt-toiu}町[まち]に行[い]ったことがありますか。
issues.problem: Introducing Kyoto, a famous city, as 'a town called Kyoto' is unnatural.
issues.action: Replaced 京都 with the less famous town 高山 and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: 「サボる」{というのは|pt-toiu}、授業[じゅぎょう]を休[やす]むことです。
issues.problem: Definition is wrong: サボる means skipping out of laziness, not simply being absent (休む).
issues.action: Definition rewritten as 授業や仕事を怠けて休むこと; English and lv (2) updated.
